text.description_html:
Emtek 2156, 7-1/4 x 2 Inch Rectangular Dummy Mortise Pocket Door Hardware

The Narrow Rectangular Dummy Mortise Pocket Door Hardware comes packaged with 2 flush pulls and a dummy mortise that has a cut out to accept a latch from a keyed or privacy pocket door mortise. This makes it able to be used on the inactive side of a pair of sliding doors. The Narrow Rectangular Dummy Pocket Door Set is available in a wide array of finishes so you'll be able to match your personal style. It will fit doors that are 1-3/8 inches thick. The trim plates are 1/8 inches thick.

Pocket Door Dummy Function: This set neither locks nor latches. It features two flush pulls and a mortise box with a built in finger edge pull to help retrieve the door from the pocket.

Also Available Matching: Passage Set, Privacy Set, and Keyed Entry Function

Specifications of the Dummy Narrow Rectangular Sliding Door Trim:

  • Face Plate Height: 7-1/4"
  • Face Plate Width: 2"
  • Face Plate Projection: 1/8"
  • Mortise Box Height: 6-1/4"
  • Mortise Box Width: 3-3/8"
  • Mortise Box Face Plate Height: 8"
  • Mortise Box Face Plate Width: 7/8"
  • Fing Grab Dimensions: 7/8"w x 2"h
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8"
  • Mortise Finger Pull: is thrown by pressing the button on the mortise's face plate. It can be retracted simply by pressing it flush with the faceplate.
  • Non-handed
  • Emtek 2156 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

*Sold as a Set: two (2) flush pulls, a dummy set mortise pull, and all mounting hardware. For One (1) Door.
